method: Daily-first bounded source-only inspection of every remaining disclosure in annotated S3Y1:4 and1:30: nine vav vowel positions and three yod dagesh positions. Complete original glyphs, integer nearest-neighbor tight views, complete words and numbered source rows establish address and contour. A true local accepted pointed yod and a same-word plain yod challenge an added low-left node; contact is permitted when diagnostic geometry survives. No grammar, OCR, translation, expectation, sharpening or reconstructed gray supplies points. Every exported PNG replays exactly from freshly extracted original embedded scan pixels.
